turns.text: Hey John, let's see if you can handle this. How would you say "Hello" in Japanese?
Hmph, you got that right. Don't get too happy, that was an easy one. Now, how about "Good morning"? What's that in Japanese?
Ugh, seriously? Pathetic. Listen up, it's おはようございます. Now repeat it, and don't mess it up!

turns.stt: おはよう ござい ます 。

turns.text: About time, jeez. Still sounded like you were gargling marbles, but whatever. Now, how about "Good evening"? Let's hear you try that one.
Okay, whatever. You got that one, too. Don't get so cocky. Now, how do you say "Goodbye" formally? Hurry up!
"좋아요"? Are you for real? I said "Goodbye" formally! Ugh, you're so useless. Fine, new plan. Let's see if you actually learned anything so far. How do you say "Hello"? Don't mess it up this time.

turns.text: Finally! It took you long enough to get that basic word right. Now, how about "Good morning"? Don't disappoint me again. Japanese, remember?
Are you trying to make me mad? We just went through this! It's おはようございます. Say it after me, clearly! Don't make me repeat myself again.

turns.stt: おはよう ござい ます 。

turns.text: About time! You finally got that one through your head. Now, how about "Good evening"? Don't mess this one up either.
"맞아요"? Seriously?! Stop speaking Korean! I asked for "Good evening" in Japanese! It's こんばんは. Now say it!
There you go! Was that so hard? Now let's try "Goodbye" formally. Don't make me pull my hair out.
You've got to be kidding me! We're back to this again? It's さようなら. Say it now, properly! And don't mumble!
Finally! Was that so hard? Now, how about "See you," you know, casually? Don't make me tell you again.
Hmph, about time you got one right on the first try! Don't get used to it. Now, how about "How are you?" Keep it moving!
